field.name: participation_id
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_PARTICIPATION
field.query: SELECT p.id AS value, CONCAT(tm.name, ' — ', t.name, ' / ', s.name, IF(s.season_year IS NULL, '', CONCAT(' (', s.season_year, ')'))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_participations AS p INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_teams AS tm ON tm.id = p.team_id INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_seasons AS s ON s.id = p.season_id INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_tournaments AS t ON t.id = s.tournament_id WHERE p.state <> -2 AND tm.state <> -2 AND s.state <> -2 AND t.state <> -2 ORDER BY s.season_year DESC, t.name ASC, tm.name ASC

field.name: player_id
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_PLAYER
field.query: SELECT p.id AS value, CONCAT(p.last_name, ' ', p.first_name, IF(p.external_ref IS NULL OR p.external_ref = '', '', CONCAT(' — ', p.external_ref))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_players AS p WHERE p.state <> -2 ORDER BY p.last_name ASC, p.first_name ASC
